applied.summary: Corrected factual misattribution: -14 LUFS was wrongly credited to AES streaming recommendations. Web-verified against AES TD1008 (v3.13) and Production Expert's summary: AES recommends ~-16 LUFS (music)/-18 LUFS (speech); -14 LUFS is a platform (Spotify/YouTube/Tidal) normalization target. Reattributed -14 LUFS to platforms and noted AES's quieter ~-16 LUFS target; -1 dBTP left as-is (correct).

Reworded the pre-fader mistake item so it no longer implies pre-fader is the norm; made explicit that post-fader is the usual default, removing the misconception trap. List preserved; only the offending item replaced.

Fixed a garbled half-sentence ('uses Slice to a new MIDI track') by naming the Ableton command explicitly: 'uses Ableton's Slice to New MIDI Track command'. Addresses both cognition and language suggestions with one edit.

Fixed ungrammatical 'names and behaves this feature the same way' -> 'names and implements this feature the same way'. List preserved; only the offending item replaced. Covers both cognition and language suggestions.
Fixed non-idiomatic zeugma ('the render hits ... the correct format') -> '... and is in the correct format'.
Fixed garbled clause 'after a note that the singer sounds buried' -> 'after noting that the lead vocal sounds buried'. List preserved; only the offending item replaced.
Resolved 'scene' collision (console scene vs theatrical scene): 'each song or scene of a musical' -> 'each song or each section of a musical'.
Fixed unclear referent: layers named 'rhythm, harmony, and lead' but text faded in 'lead and percussion'. Changed 'percussion' to 'rhythm layers' to match the named layers.
